speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mistress, I am come for the length, if the basket can spare it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It can spare a length. It cannot spare the afternoon I spent winding it. Alse.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have the red. Say the length and I will cut it on my arm, not by a guess in the air.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An arm's length. Enough to tie a bundle and not enough to sew a sleeve.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: An arm's length, on my own arm.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That will do. Thank you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And what is it tying, that it must be red and it must be tonight?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fair copy of what I have of the lovers. The brawl, the feast, the orchard, the friar's cell, the fight, the banishment, and the dawn that is already in the papers. It is coherent. It is not finished.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If it is not finished, why tie it? A tied thing looks like a thing a man is done with.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not done with it. The marks stay in the margin, where the men will need them. I will not write finished on the first leaf. Finished is not a useful word until other people have done their part of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the thread is only to keep the leaves from walking. I understand a thread better than a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is all it is. The bundle goes on this side of the board. The folder of private verse stays on the other side. No leaf wanders from one to the other.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See that it does not. I will not have verse in the pottage because a man keeps two kinds of paper on one board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are apart. And before I begin another correction, I write three lines home. The letter is not the thing that waits.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Three lines is a decent letter to a wife. Twopence is Thursday's, when the carrier has it. Do not pay me today for a letter that is still on your table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. Thursday pays the letter. Tonight I only write it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is coming for the Holinshed. Shall I shut it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him sit. He has sat on it before, and the book is none the worse.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The hall candle is the firing, and you have had it. If you mean to write after, you light your own upstairs. I have counted candles in this house long enough to know whose socket is whose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Upstairs is mine. I will burn one, and I will stop when the three lines are done.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The thread is on the corner. Do not let the cat have the end of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The end is for the knot.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then knot it, and write your three lines, and leave my basket where Alse put it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will. It is coherent. It is not finished. That is the whole of the news.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the dawn you speak of. Is it a new dawn, or the one you sat up for?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The one already written. I am fairing it, Mistress. I am not making it again tonight.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the red is enough. I have the scissors, and I am taking them back to the basket.
